content: Go IBus engine precedent: sarim/goibus (cgo bindings to libibus) powers ibus-avro (Bangla, packaged in Ubuntu/Debian) and bambooengine/ibus-bamboo (Vietnamese). No known pure-Go (godbus-only, no-cgo) IBus engine exists - goswitch would be first, so M1 must prove the raw D-Bus handshake against ibus-daemons private bus (RegisterComponent, Factory, Engine object, capability negotiation) on IBus 1.5.29 (Ubuntu 24.04).
